signed_weights: source export; acetylcholine positive, GABA/glutamate negative
synaptic_delay: 2 buffered update steps plus causal update ordering; no_delay uses current state
task_relay: 8 synthetic leaky rate units, 25 ms, one-hot input
readout: sum of leg motor-neuron rates / 40 Hz; equal-weight untrained linear readout
feedback: 10 * clipped joint error/contact feedback into E1; engineered projection
body: six independent 2R legs, link lengths 0.65, inertia 0.08, viscous damping 0.25, PD gains 32 and 1.4, torque limit 8
contact: unilateral spring 180, damper 1.5; force threshold 0.04; model units
noise: parameter draws per seed; sensory Normal(0,0.25) only in noisy condition
safety: all nonfinite numerical states raise; no replacement with fabricated zeros
